headline: $6,862 Million Leaves Crypto Exchanges As Bitcoin Trades Near 79k
narrative: Crypto exchanges recorded a net outflow of $6,862 million over the past day, equal to 2.6258 percent of reserves. The outflow is the accumulation pipe: those coins departed the venues where sellers would have offered them, and that is where the money is going. Bitcoin traded near 79k as the inventory moved off the venues.
author: jordan
